text.en:
The islands of Sarangani and Balut, both in the Municipality of Jose Abad Santos, Province of
Davao del Sur, are hereby detached and separated therefrom to form and constitute a distinct and independent
municipality to be known as the Municipality of Sarangani without affecting in any manner the legal existence
of the mother municipality of Jose Abad Santos. The seat of the government of the newly-created municipality
shall be in Barangay Mabila, in the island of Balut.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable to regular
municipalities, shall be applicable to the Municipality of Sarangani.

The present elective municipal officials of the Municipality of Jose Abad Santos shall continue
to perform their duties as such officials in the newly-created Municipality of Jose Abad Santos until the
municipal officials of said municipality shall have been appointed by the President. Such officials so
appointed shall hold office until their successors shall have been elected in the regular elections for municipal
officials following the issuance of this Decree and shall have qualified, unless sooner removed at the pleasure
of the President. Such appointive officers and employees as may be necessary to organize or to complete the
government personnel of the Municipality of Sarangani shall be appointed as provided under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of Sarangani in the obligations,
funds, assets and other property of the Municipality of Jose Abad Santos shall be transferred by the President
of the newly-created municipality upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as all executive orders or regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
